stepTitle: Two children are balanced on a seesaw of negligible mass. The first child exerts $$254.8\, \text{N}$$ of gravitational force and sits $$1.60\, \text{m}$$ from the pivot. The second child exerts $$313.6\, \text{N}$$ of gravitational force and sits $$1.3\, \text{m}$$ from the pivot. Assume a mass of $$12.0\, \text{kg}$$ for the seesaw. What is $$F_{p},$$ the supporting force exerted by the pivot? Give the force to the nearest newton (in $$\text{N})$$.
